quickStart:
The user is watching Pixel_8_API_37_2 (Android 17.0) in the Device panel.
Drive it with /Users/eros/.t3/userdata/device/targets/t3-78f39ef5f82e05c862b586fa/agent-device. It is bound to this device and session, so it needs no --platform, --udid, --serial, --config or --session flags. Use this exact path; login shells may reset PATH.
Every app launch, deep link, tap, text entry, alert, setting, screenshot and recording on this device goes through it. Run open <bundle-or-package-id> (apps lists them) before snapshots, CLI screenshots or input; it starts the session they need. Use device_screenshot just to look.

Prefer snapshot refs over coordinates. Run /Users/eros/.t3/userdata/device/targets/t3-78f39ef5f82e05c862b586fa/agent-device help <command> for flags and /Users/eros/.t3/userdata/device/targets/t3-78f39ef5f82e05c862b586fa/agent-device help workflow for guides.
Do not use simctl, idb, adb or ssh for those actions. They stay fine for builds, installs, code sync, Metro, port forwards, logs, test runners and what this command cannot do; come back to it for every UI action and screenshot so the user can watch.
